request: Please find me data regarding first-of-class ship cost overruns

reply.reply: The latest verified CRS material provides first-in-class carrier cost figures, but it does not establish an overrun amount because the cited passages lack an original baseline. CVN-78’s final procurement cost was $13,316.5 million in then-year dollars (CRS RS20643, PDF p. 7). The FY2026 estimate for CVN-79 is $13,196.0 million, with $150.0 million requested to cover cost growth—again, not a quantified overrun against a baseline (CRS RS20643, PDF p. 8). See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261021-172315-2645.html) for citations and evidence.
reply.reasoning: Recent CRS evidence supplies first-of-class and related lead-ship dollar values plus cost-growth funding, but does not permit calculating a baseline-to-current overrun.
